name: tool-path-resolution
body: The act of resolving a stored, checkout-independent graph identity back to an absolute filesystem path at the consumer boundary. It is the bridge between the portable artifact and the world of editors and file handles: the graph holds the repo-relative identity, and a consumer that asks to open a file receives the absolute path of that file in its own checkout. This is the tool-boundary instance of graph-identity, alongside the frontends' module-identity instances.
